newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CLARK BACK IN THE MANAGERIAL HOT SEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CLARK BACK IN THE MANAGERIAL HOT SEAT.

text.p: Frank Clark was named as manager of Manchester City on Sunday -- just 10 days after quitting as boss of premier league strugglers Nottingham Forest.
Clark's appointment was confirmed by City secretary David Halford shortly after Phil Neal had become the third boss to part company with the troubled first division club this year.
Former England international Neal took over in a caretaker capacity after Steve Coppell's surprise resignation in November.
But he has not been able to halt the team's slide, winning just two games out of 10.
Clark quit as Forest boss on December 19 after he had expressed frustration at his inability to spend money on new players as protracted takeover negotiations left the club's future unclear.
He had taken over from Brian Clough in May 1993.
